name: StanleyCupScreen
note: same job as 95G StanleyCupScreen: loads StanleyCupMap, prints the winner A and the team X it beat from the strings at $C350A9-$C350D6, the winner's logo sprite, sprites each frame until start; CODE_C401E5 calls it, then SeasonAwards, then Reset

name: SeasonAwards
note: same job as 95G SeasonAwards (the awards after the season); 95 SNES shows one winner per award (no finalists) and steps through the awards with left / right; CODE_C401E5 calls it after StanleyCupScreen

name: DrawAward
note: prints AwardNames / AwardDescs of award a0 and unpacks AwardPictures (CODE_C5881C); SeasonAwards calls it for each award shown

name: FindAwardWinner
note: jumps through AwardScanTbl by award a0 (the AwardNames order); the routines return the winning player (team for the Presidents Trophy) in A

name: ScanVezina
note: AwardScanTbl entry 0 (Vezina Trophy, Best Goalkeeper); goalies of all 26 teams ($2E03 list, $2DCB count), the highest CODE_C5BDA8 score

name: ScanSelke
note: AwardScanTbl entry 1 (Frank J. Selke Trophy, Best Defensive Forward); team from CODE_C4DF5B (lowest standings word $2A), forwards by CODE_C5BD52 + CODE_C5BD7D

name: ScanConnSmythe
note: AwardScanTbl entry 2 (Conn Smythe Trophy, Most Valuable Player in Playoffs); the 16 playoff teams ($3075A4), skaters scored by CODE_C4DF82 + CODE_C4DFAC

name: ScanJennings
note: AwardScanTbl entry 3 (William M. Jennings Trophy, Goalie with fewest goals against); team from CODE_C4DF5B, its goalies by CODE_C5BDE7

name: ScanHart
note: AwardScanTbl entry 4 (Hart Memorial Trophy, Most Valuable Player); teams sorted by the standings word $0A, then each skater's goals + assists against the team total (Div32x32U)

name: ScanArtRoss
note: AwardScanTbl entry 5 (Art Ross Trophy, Most Points); every player (team from the nibble table at $306A56), goalies skipped, CODE_C5BD52 + CODE_C5BD7D

name: ScanNorris
note: AwardScanTbl entry 6 (James Norris Memorial Trophy, Best Defenseman); team from CODE_C4DF5B, its defencemen ($2DCF count after the goalies and forwards) by CODE_C5BD52 + CODE_C5BD7D

name: ScanPresidents
note: AwardScanTbl entry 7 (Presidents Trophy, Best regular season record); the 26 teams' records from CODE_C5B97F

name: DrawAwardWinner
note: the team from CODE_C5B5EA, the team name (DATA8_C3585C), the photo ($0480 bytes, 48 x 48 4bpp, unpacked by CODE_C4EC88) or the logo sprite, the name from the roster; SeasonAwards for awards 0-6

name: DrawPresidentsWinner
note: team A's name (DATA8_C3585C) and logo sprite; SeasonAwards for award 7

name: ShowScoringSummary
note: same job as 94S ShowScoringSummary (the scoring summary screen of the pause menu); the item Score Summry of the pause menu's first tab (jump table DATA8_C5501C, item list $C35CCB)

name: ShowPenaltySummary
note: same job as 94S ShowPenaltySummary; the item Penalties of the pause menu's first tab (DATA8_C5501C)

name: ShowGameStats
note: same job as 94S ShowGameStats; the item Game Stats of the pause menu's second tab (DATA8_C55026, item list $C35CEF)

name: ShowPeriodStats
note: same job as 94S ShowPeriodStats; the item Period Stats of the pause menu's second tab (DATA8_C55026)

name: DrawPeriodStats
note: same job as 94S DrawPeriodStats (goals or shots for each period and the total); ShowPeriodStats calls it again when B switches

name: ShowPlayerStats
note: same job as 94S ShowPlayerStats (player stats for the team in a2, sorted by a column); the item Player Stats of the pause menu's second tab (DATA8_C55026)

name: ShowOtherScores
note: same job as 94S ShowOtherScores; the item Other Scores of the pause menu's first tab (DATA8_C5501C); CODE_C5AF07 also calls it

name: TeamRoster
note: same job as 94S TeamRoster (PauseTeamRoster: the roster screen of a team); the item Team Roster of the pause menu's first tab (DATA8_C5501C)

name: EditLinesScreen
note: same job as 94S EditLinesScreen (PauseEditLines: change the lines on the ice); the item Edit Lines of the pause menu's options tab (DATA8_C5502C, item list $C35D07)

name: PauseGoalieMode
note: same job as 94S PauseGoalieMode (GetPadTeam, then the team's goaliemode1 word switched); the fourth item of the options tab (DATA8_C5502C), whose text the mode picks

name: PauseTimeout
note: same job as 94S PauseTimeout (a timeout of the pausing team: count down, reenergizeteam, the message); the fifth item of the options tab (DATA8_C5502C); with none left it goes to CODE_C56B80

name: GetPadTeam
note: same job as 94S GetPadTeam (a2 = 0 or 2 from the pause pad and cont1team); the pause menu items call it first

name: reenergizeteam
note: the same loop as 94S reenergizeteam (tmpde = $1000; the tmpdst check $FFFD then $FFFC never passes, in 94S too); counts with X where 94S counts with d0; PauseTimeout calls it

name: ScoutingReport
note: same job as 94S ScoutingReport (both teams, the matchups and the scrolling commentary until start; Y previous, A next, X restarts the report) and 95G ScoutingReport; prints Scouting Report ($C34C9F)

name: ShowMatchups
note: same job as 94S ShowMatchups (the matchups box: matchup curitem, both players or teams); 95 keeps the matchup number in $2DA5 and prints Goalie and Overall from the packed text

name: NextMatchup
note: adds 1 to the matchup number ($2DA5), wrapping at 7, and draws it; ScoutingReport on its timer and on A

name: PrevMatchup
note: subtracts 1 from the matchup number ($2DA5), wrapping to 6, and draws it; ScoutingReport on Y

name: BuildScoutingText
note: appends packed strings ($C34DB9, $C34DC8, $C34DED, $C34DFA ...) and the teams' names with AppendScoutText to the buffer at $364E; ScoutingReport scrolls it

name: AppendScoutText
note: CODE_C4C3BA unpacks the packed string at $C3:X, then the bytes are copied to $364E + $81 up to the zero, $81 moved on; BuildScoutingText calls it for each piece

name: TradePlayers
note: same job as 95G TradePlayers (the two rosters with position and rating, choose players, start checks the trade); CODE_C5CB36 draws it, the marks are bit 0 of the lists at $364E / $36B2

name: GMDecisionScreen
note: same job as 95G GMDecisionScreen (the GM's verdict on the trade; start executes it, a button goes back to TradePlayers)

name: DrawGMDecision
note: leaves through CODE_C58D32 when neither side chose anyone; the texts $C34D53 Accepted, $C34D5A Rejected, $C34B7F Illegal:, $C34D61 Advantage:

name: PrintTradedPlayers
note: same job as 95G PrintTradedPlayers (the players of a trade list); 95 SNES prints up to 8, then Etc. ($C34D4A); No Selections is $C34D3F

name: CheckTrade
note: the roster rules of 95G CheckTrade: after the trade each team has 2-3 goalies, 9-15 forwards, 6-15 defencemen and at most 25 players; the values come from TradeValue for each side

name: TradeValue
note: same job as 95G TradeValue (the value of the chosen players from their ratings), with the counts of 95G CountChosen; CheckTrade calls it for both sides

name: ExecuteTrade
note: same job as 95G ExecuteTrade; writes the team nibble of each chosen player in the save RAM table at $306A56 (the home list to $17CB, the away list to $17C9); GMDecisionScreen calls it

name: SeasonOptions
note: same job as 95G SeasonOptions (the season mode menu); the page at $C356A4 (League Menu); sets the screen state $99 = 6 (DATA8_C5967A: CODE_C5AC07); the season screens jump back to it

name: GamesToday
note: same job as 95G GamesToday (the day's games, a button toggles human / computer, left / right the day, start exits); the page at $C3568E

name: StandingsScreen
note: same job as 95G StandingsScreen (NHL STANDINGS by conference / division); the page at $C35553

name: LeagueLeadersScreen
note: same job as 95G LeagueLeadersScreen (the stat leader lists of the season menu); the page at $C3556D printed from CODE_C5AFCC, which it falls into

name: SeasonTeamStats
note: same job as 95G SeasonTeamStats (the season team stats screen); the page at $C355F1 (Season Team Stats); sets the screen state $99 = 9 (CODE_C5A623)

name: SeasonPlayerStats
note: same job as 95G SeasonPlayerStats (the season player stats screen); the page at $C35583 (Season Player Stats)

name: SignFreeAgents
note: same job as 95G SignFreeAgents; the page at $C353AB (Hire Free Agents); play mode Free Agent of the setup screen (DATA8_C58DD0 entry 4)

name: ReleasePlayers

note: Word source reader; carries to the next bank at offset $8000.

note: Uploads tables to sound RAM $F600 / $F480 / $F580 / $FD00; DSP directory is within the final block.

note: CPU StartSound supplies A; low IDs go through tcall 10 and high IDs index the sequence pointer table.

note: Allocates a sample voice then writes ports 1/2 directly to DSP pitch.

name: .playSampleVolume
note: CPU StartSoundVolume passes tmp0 as the stereo volume; tcall 2 scales each side.

name: .playSamplePacked
note: Low/high nibbles of X become left/right volume times 8; signed Y times 16 is added to default pitch.

name: .fadeVoicesOut
note: Saves DSP voice volumes to FFE0/FFE8 and decrements with zero clamp in repeated sweeps.

name: .fadeVoicesIn
note: Increments each DSP voice volume and clamps to saved left/right values.

name: .setMasterVolume
note: CPU SoundVolumeUp and SoundVolumeDown send stereo master-volume steps.

name: .stopSequences
note: Clears playback flag then tcall 15 resets count/list/free contexts and keys off voices.

name: .setSequenceVolume
note: Writes default context volume; sequence allocation copies it to context offset B7.

name: .setTickPeriod
note: Sets timer 0 divider directly and its cached reset value.

name: .disableSamples
note: Sets bit 5 checked by commands 1-4 on sample paths; falls through stopSamples.

name: .enableSamples
note: Clears bit 5 tested by the sample start commands.

name: .stopSamples
note: Tests signed channel slot per voice; negative slots identify sample voices.

name: .setSampleVolumeScale
note: Writes the multiplier read by tcall 2; scale divisor is 127.

name: .setSampleVolume
note: Writes FD02/FD03 at slot A times four; does not use the sample ID remap.

name: .setSamplePitch
note: Writes FD00/FD01 at slot A times four; does not use the sample ID remap.

name: .setPlayingSampleVolume
note: Finds raw sample slot A in voice records; live volumes are bitwise ANDed with the sample scale.

name: .setPlayingSamplePitch
note: Finds raw sample slot A in voice records; writes DSP pitch and falls through default update.

name: .stopSample
note: tcall 11 matches raw sample slot; queue fallback compares A with queued argument 0 without remapping.

name: .resetSound
note: Also called during init; restores volume 127 and timer period A0 then keys off all voices.

name: .stopAndReceiveData
note: CPU UploadSoundData sends command 19 hex; stops sequences and voices before entering receiveData.

name: .receiveData
note: Nonnegative port 3 counters carry three bytes; 81-83 finish with one to three bytes; returns 7E.

name: .keyOffAll
note: Descending voice loop invokes key-off helper for each voice.

name: .reportVoiceAges
note: Age counters saturate at FF; reports max(15-age,0) nibbles in two handshaken pairs.

name: .commandNoOp
note: Handler consists only of RET.

name: .setSampleEnvelope
note: Reads F580/F581 indexed by sample slot times two; ADSR1 sign selects ADSR2 versus GAIN.

name: .scaleSequenceVolume
note: Context offset B7 holds the volume captured at sequence start.

name: .scaleSampleVolume
note: Multiplier set by command 18; shared MUL/DIV tail with sequence volume scaling.

name: .scalePitchFraction
note: Computes unsigned pitch fraction for tcall 4 from scratch word 02/03 and doubled magnitude A.

name: .applyChannelPitchBend
note: Signed channel parameter through 3F selects adding/subtracting a scaled half-pitch baseline.

name: .setDefaultSampleVolume
note: Reads FD02/FD03 then scales through tcall 2 and writes DSP volume registers.

name: .setDefaultSamplePitch
note: Reads FD00/FD01 and writes the selected voice's DSP pitch registers.

name: .readStreamBit
note: Per-channel byte pointer and shift buffer are advanced when the remaining bit count expires.

name: .keyOffVoice
note: Writes DSP_KOF; marks voice for availability next tick and clears loop protection and ownership.

name: .readEventDelay
note: Stores delay low/high counters through 37/39; tick decrements these before reading the next event.

name: .prepareSampleVoice
note: Configures SRCN and envelope; carry clear on success; nonzero auxiliary high byte permits queuing.

name: .findSampleVoice
note: Compares raw slot against 4F+X; saves input A/X in scratch for the command handlers.

name: .keyOnVoice
note: First use writes FLG 20; clears KOF then writes KON and clears the free-voice mask bit.

name: .findFreeVoice
note: Searches free-voice bitmask from voice 7 downward; carry clear on success.

name: .readPackedEventByte
note: Reads unary length then index bits through tcall 7; dictionary address patched per sequence.

name: .resetSequenceState
